## Kritikal affirmatives

Affirmative rounds assigned to Kritikal affirmative (`kritikal-aff`): a file of the round holds no plan text and a K-aff marker (a role of the ballot, an advocacy statement, `The 1AC is` or a method label), or the team's other rounds are assigned to it. A round whose plan text names an aff, or that another signal identifies, is not counted here. The markers are counted and never quoted.

3 affirmative rounds by 2 teams: 2 by a marker in the round's own file, 1 carried from the team's other rounds.

1 round was not carried into because its own file reads an advantage.

K families named in the K-aff files' headings, counted from their words and never placed: Capitalism, 3 files (2 teams); Settler colonialism, 1 file (1 team); Afropessimism, 1 file (1 team).

2 of 7 affirmative rounds (28.6%) still have no identified aff.
